sentences.text:
At the outset, it is worth to mention that, the chargesheet has been NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.A/3000/2024 ORDER DATED: 07/02/2025 undefined filed on 12.08.2024 and thereafter,
the appellant had approached Sessions Court and then preferred Criminal Appeal No.1520/2024 before this Court, wherein, coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 11.10.2024 after perusing chargesheet case papers, had been pleased to dispose of the appeal as withdrawn.
4.

The applicant is failed to show any changed circumstances in the matter and after filing of the chargesheet, it is only argued that merely there was love affair between the appellant and victim, is not a ground to entertain this application and release the applicant on bail without changed circumstances as the same ground was available at the time of filing earlier appeal also.
Hence, this Court is not inclined to exercise jurisdiction in absence of any change in the circumstances.
5. In view of the above, the Court is not inclined to grant bail.
Nonetheless, after filing of the chargesheet, it strengthens the case of the prosecution.

In this regard, reference is made to the decision of the Apex Court in the case of Virupakshappa Gouda & Anr. Vs. The State of Karnataka &
Anr. reported in 2017 (5) SCC 406 and Navin Singh Vs. State of U.P. reported in 2021 (2) SCC (Cri.)
809 as filing of chargesheet does not any manner lesser the allegation, but filing of chargesheet is only a cosmetic change.

6. For the foregoing reasons, appeal is dismissed.

However, as the appellant is undertrial prisoner,
trial be expedited.
